desc: Firework spirit: round dark violet bomb-like body with red crystal fuse spikes and a gold cap. Face: wide startled round eyes with tiny pupils, a small wavy mouth. Abstract spirit creature, no animal parts. Cute and cool chibi, right-facing 3/4. 16-bit pixel art, 1px navy outline, 2-3 flat shades, no gradients, no noise. Lavender, white, violet, gold palette. No halo, sparkles or shadow.
